principles: A byte revision is not automatically a logical-data revision.
A schema rename must not be inferred from drop+add without stable field identity or an explicit mapping.
Reference identifiers outrank labels for joins; fuzzy label matching never creates authoritative identity.
Source/revision time and processing/observation time are distinct.
Git history is the natural change log for Git-hosted source data; Debezium is not applied to Git.
Streaming watermarks are not applied to bounded historical revision ingestion.
Iceberg is activated only when table-level snapshot/evolution/concurrent-writer/time-travel requirements exceed Git+Parquet+manifest.

activationGates.iceberg: Do not activate for the current pilot: immutable Git revisions already supply snapshot identity and there is no multi-writer table state. Activate only for real table-level schema/partition evolution, atomic snapshots/time travel, concurrent writers or row-level lineage/update needs.
activationGates.debezium: Do not activate for Git sources. Activate at a database boundary when transaction-log CDC is required.
activationGates.beam: Do not activate for bounded Git history. Activate when an unbounded source requires event-time windows/watermarks/late-data handling.
activationGates.redpandaKafka: Do not activate merely to transport bounded revision files; require a proven decoupled event-stream/replay/fan-out workload.
